name: Ulvestad Variation — Black Tactics
description: 4 tactical challenges for Black in the Ulvestad Variation. Find the precise counter-attacking sequences to press Black's initiative, keep the knights active, and fight for compensation against White's central control.

drills.name: Nd4 Central Outpost
drills.briefExplanation: Black places the knight on the powerful d4 square. After c3 attacks it, Nxd5 recaptures the pawn.
drills.explanation: Nxd5 recaptures the pawn. Black continues with 8...c6, solidifying. The Nd4 disrupts White's plans before recapturing on d5 — Black maintains material equality while keeping the initiative with active piece play in the open center.

drills.name: c6 Solidification
drills.briefExplanation: Black plays Qh4 to create counter-threats, and after d3, c6 supports the d5 knight.
drills.explanation: c6 supports d5. Black follows with 10...Be7, developing and preparing castling. The queen on h4 creates immediate pressure on White's kingside while c6 gives the d5 knight a solid base — Black fights for the initiative in the sharp Ulvestad position.

drills.name: Be7 Development
drills.briefExplanation: Black retreats the d5 knight to f6 and after Bg5 pins it, plays Be7 to develop and prepare castling.
drills.explanation: Be7 prepares castling. Black continues with 11...0-0, bringing the king to safety. By playing Nf6 and then Be7, Black develops smoothly and prepares to castle, completing development while maintaining the material imbalance in the dynamic Ulvestad position.

drills.name: Qb6 Counter-attack
drills.briefExplanation: Black challenges the bishop with h6, and after Bh4 retreats, Qb6 creates counter-threats.
drills.explanation: Qb6 attacks b2 and supports the center. Black follows with 12...0-0, completing development. The queen on b6 attacks White's b-pawn while eyeing the center — Black generates real counter-play and keeps the compensation alive in the unbalanced Ulvestad position.
